question: NordVPN remains #1 by US VPN install share at 2026-06-30, with US iOS App Store rank <= 15 in Utilities category.
resolution_criterion: On or around 2026-06-30, NordVPN US iOS App Store Utilities rank is <= 15 AND NordVPN US VPN market share (per any publicly disclosed Sensor Tower tier, Statista, or equivalent source) is >= 25%. Resolves YES if both conditions hold, NO if either fails.
